description.en: A reserved field. This field has no effect.

description.zh:
待解绑HDFS文件系统的ECS实例ID。

添加多个ECS实例ID时，请使用半角逗号（,）间隔，建议添加不超过50个ECS实例ID。
description.en:
The ECS instance IDs to detach from the HDFS file system.

Separate multiple ECS instance IDs with commas. We recommend that you specify no more than 50 ECS instance IDs.

description.zh:
是否使用扮演者检验计算节点权限。

- true：是
- false（默认值）：否
description.en:
Whether to use role assumption to check permissions on compute nodes.

- true

- false (default)

description.zh:
待解绑HDFS文件系统的VSC ID。

建议添加不超过50个VSC ID。
description.en:
The VSC IDs to detach from the HDFS file system.

We recommend that you specify no more than 50 VSC IDs.
